# The folder-settings test waits for the requested account selection after page loading

The test now waits until #accounttree li.selected has account.key, then repeats the equality assertion. TabOpen, foreground/content-tab checks, document load and URI checks are earlier separate steps. The removed next-turn timer did not express this selected-account state. The exact predicate assumes a selected row exists; no harness null/error behavior or reproduced intermittent cure is inferred.

Scope: Folder-context account-settings test readiness.
